en: A vintage illustrated postcard with multiple vignettes of city views. The main scene shows a riverside panorama with historic buildings and a church tower along the Mur river, with a hill topped by a fortress in the background. Smaller images depict a city square, a theater building with a domed roof, a tall lookout tower in a park, and a lake with trees and boats. The central caption reads "Gruss aus Graz," and the vignettes are labeled with German place names.
